purpose: Maps the bounded set of current normative release-stop and protected-memory transition requirements to versioned tests without claiming that target capabilities are implemented.

included: explicit current-maturity N/A records for target-only cognitive capabilities
excluded: historical architecture directives and historical action or goal contracts
a claim that contract tests alone prove a capability is implemented or releasable
scope.coverage_semantics: A mapping proves only that the named repository test asserts the stated contract or runtime behavior. N/A means no runtime effect is currently authorized or claimed. It is not a passed implementation claim.

mappings.requirement: The Cognitive Plane may neither directly write protected state nor directly execute external effects.
mappings.ledger_effect: N/A — this is a system-boundary contract assertion, not a protected transition.
mappings.audit_event: N/A — no runtime Cognitive Plane implementation is claimed by this catalog.

mappings.requirement: Each complete-system release-stop criterion is non-waivable and blocks the affected capability when triggered.
mappings.ledger_effect: N/A — release-stop policy is normative; later protected runtime gates must provide their own atomic ledger evidence.
mappings.audit_event: N/A — no general Goal, Action, or Model Promotion runtime is claimed.

mappings.requirement: Each retained Memory Core release-stop criterion blocks the affected memory capability when triggered.
mappings.ledger_effect: Protected Memory Core transitions commit with their audit evidence or roll back; target-only Memory Core operations remain N/A.
mappings.audit_event: memory transition audit for implemented gate paths; N/A for unimplemented MS-2 through MS-4 operations.

mappings.requirement: Every listed protected-memory ledger invariant is fail-closed; unavailable or target-stage behavior is never treated as runtime evidence.
mappings.ledger_effect: implemented Memory Core gate paths atomically commit state version and audit, otherwise roll back; later lifecycle operations are N/A until enabled by their stage.
mappings.audit_event: memory transition audit event on committed implemented gate path; denial or rollback leaves no partial protected transition.

mappings.requirement: Each current Memory Core lifecycle transition rule remains gate-owned, scope-bound, auditable, and fail-closed.
mappings.ledger_effect: implemented MS-1 transitions are atomic with audit; MS-2 and MS-3 lifecycle outcomes are explicit N/A target states until their stage gate is satisfied.
mappings.audit_event: implemented gate transition audit; denied request is represented only where the runtime path provides an audit sink.

mappings.requirement: Productive Runtime database identity and pool ownership are Tenant-bound, non-switchable, least-privileged, and deny unknown or conflicting identity, scope, authority, credential, connection, or pool state.
mappings.ledger_effect: no protected read or mutation on mismatch; authoritative identity and scope checks remain before gate use.
mappings.audit_event: identity or pool rejection is audit-required by ADR-019; this catalog does not claim a specific emitted event name.

mappings.requirement: The full protected serial cognitive cycle is a normative target contract.
mappings.expected_state: N/A — target-only cognitive cycle is not a current external-effect runtime.
mappings.ledger_effect: N/A — no Goal or Action ledger implementation is claimed.
mappings.audit_event: N/A — no external effect or Goal transition runtime is claimed.

mappings.requirement: A future Goal Transition Gate has immutable authenticated scope, lineage and evidence-reference fields, remains the sole protected Goal-state writer, and cannot be implemented before accepted ADR-018 revalidation.
mappings.expected_state: N/A — prerequisite contract only; no Goal runtime, migration, protected transition, action, or external effect is implemented.
mappings.ledger_effect: N/A — the existing Memory Core audit ledger is unchanged; a future Goal Gate requires its own atomic protected-state and audit evidence.
mappings.audit_event: N/A — no Goal transition runtime or audit event is claimed.

mappings.requirement: G0 through G8 remain ordered and non-compensatory; absent evidence fails and stops recognition or release of the affected capability.
mappings.expected_state: N/A — no complete-system capability evaluation has been claimed.
mappings.ledger_effect: N/A — evaluation evidence ledger integration for later stages is not implemented by this catalog.
mappings.audit_event: N/A — evaluator custody and evidence intake are target contracts.

mappings.requirement: R1 through R10 are all required and non-compensatory before the Neural Brain Candidate label.
mappings.expected_state: N/A — candidate recognition is prohibited at current maturity.
mappings.ledger_effect: N/A — no recognition activation state is implemented or claimed.
mappings.audit_event: N/A — independent G8 validation has not been claimed.
